_doc: Echoes of the Logos selfie portrait generator and fantasy JRPG filter settings.
disclaimerText: Channeling your physical likeness into the Chronicles of Solaria will project your portrait into the fellowship dialogue, battle HUD, and status codex. Step forward to capture your visage, or keep the traditional hero illustration.
sourceDialogSubtitle: Snap a real selfie or select an existing portrait to immortalize your hero in Solaria.
